title: Ultron tool manifest
description: Contract for a single tool. Read by the registry (validation), the policy gate (risk + permissions), the sandbox (entrypoint + permissions) and the verifier (inputs/outputs).

version.description: Semver. Multiple versions may coexist; plans can pin one.

entrypoint.description: Shell-free argv string executed inside the sandbox, relative to the repo mount. Shell metacharacters are rejected.

description.description: What the tool does. Used by the deterministic planner search.

risk.description: low = auto-approve (still sandboxed), medium = human approval, high = deny unless a pinned approval exists.

permissions.description: Declared capabilities. network:* is only granted when this list asks for it (and the policy gate approves). secrets:* is denied in Phase 1.

inputs.description: Input schema: field name -> type. The policy gate validates actual values against this before execution a tool is ever started.

outputs.description: Output schema: field name -> type. The verifier checks the tool's JSON result against this.

tags.description: Free-form keywords for deterministic registry search.

deterministic.description: True when the tool never calls an LLM. Deterministic tools are preferred by the planner because they cost $0 and cache perfectly.

timeout_s.description: Requested sandbox timeout. Clamped to the harness ceiling.

cache_ttl_s.description: How long tool outputs stay cacheable. 0 disables caching for this tool.

price_estimate_usd.description: Expected spend per invocation, used by the planner's cost model.
